title: schrankia angustisiliqua
intro: Schrankia angustisiliqua, commonly known as the Indian spikenard, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, helping to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Schrankia angustisiliqua are attributed to its ability to exhibit sedative and anticonvulsant properties, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and epilepsy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
